scope: supplied evidence and parent code; no direct device observation

limitations: Supplied-evidence limitation: this was a no-tools static review; I cannot claim direct device observation. All runtime artifacts (device-report.json, collection.json, allocator-policy-collected.json, observed-summary.json, policy-continuation-frozen.json) were collected and verified by the parent process, not by me. The evidence chain is parent-asserted and I treat it as such.

The read-only continuation (collect_policy_report_path.py) only re-runs adapter.main('preflight') + collect_policy against the already-collected emulator report. It does NOT re-dispatch models or re-run inference. All speech quality metrics (WER/CER, 117 decode calls, 65 completed rows, 52 non-empty / 13 strict-empty) originate from the single original emulator run whose frozen adapter input hashes passed before+after and were not altered.

nativePolicyEffectVerified remains false. The policy collection only confirms receiptMatches/fileBytesMatch and a bounded 20-byte read (limit 21) with matching UID/device/inode; it does not establish that the native allocator policy had any behavioral effect on recognition (causalAttributionVerified=false).

Cross-environment agreement is non-causal. TECNO 24/24 identical raw outputs and Mac WER/CER proximity are correlation signals; they do not prove a single runtime cause and must not be read as causal attribution.

TECNO comparison coverage is only 24/65 files (20 mandarin + 4 english-near); it has zero english-far (AMI) and zero challenge (silence/noise) coverage. Results cannot be generalized to the full 65-input corpus.

Emulator evidence cannot substitute for phone acceptance, sustained/warm-run behavior, power draw, or true-peak memory. truePeakMeasured=false; only sampled RSS (max 1.433GiB) was measured. W3/R4/R5 remain open per the docs, and this item is explicitly a supplemental fixed-corpus quality passage only.

The prior free hy3 pre-run static review accepted with no findings but missed the adapter literal-count defect (count==2, not the asserted 1). This confirms the documented limitation of pre-run review; the defect was preserved (collect.stderr retained, no original frozen artifacts modified) and correctly recovered by the read-only continuation with three passing offline regression checks plus one same-run bound collection.

No concrete blockers or scope changes identified. Documented boundaries (not W3 completion, not R4/R5, not phone acceptance, not independent held-out, not native-policy-effectiveness) are consistently and honestly stated across reportMarkdown, roadmapPrepend, handoffPrepend, pitfallsPrepend, and publicationBody; internal numeric claims (hashes, counts, cohort error rates, RTF range, cleanup bytes) match observed-summary.json and the frozen/continued artifacts.
